title: ** Austin Selects New City Hall Design
summary:
• **New City Hall approved**: The council adopted architect A.P. Page Jr.'s plans and specifications for a new City Hall building after reviewing proposals from multiple architects, with a builder's bid guaranteeing construction costs.

• **Construction moving forward**: The architect was directed to finalize plans and advertise for construction bids, while a committee was tasked with finding temporary office space for city officials during construction.

• **Awning permit pending**: A petition from Mrs. Shileax to erect an awning was referred to the ordinance committee for review, along with a proposed amendment to the city's awning regulations.

Austin, Texas, Aug. 6. 1906
Horton W. Shelley Mayor, & Board of Aldermen, City of Austin
Gentlemen:
We, your special Committee appointed by you Csk Page Jr. plans to advertise for plans and
specifications for a new City Hall & instruct for the City of Austin beg leave to report
that we have Mayor respectfully examined the plans and specifications Hall submitted to
your Committee and recommend the adoption of plans and specifications submitted by Wm. B.
Page Jr, Architect for the following reasons First we believe that plans submitted by him
are best suited to the needs of the City and will meet all of our requirements for a
number years.
Second that said plans and specifications are accompanied by a Certified Check for five
hundred dollars and a bona fide bid from a responsible builder of this City, which
guarantees the erection of the building for the amount stated in the estimate, Said bid
and Certified Check are herewith attached & this report.
And we further recommend that the Mayor be instructed to enter into Contract with Wm. B.
Page Jr. for plans and specifications for the erection of the building in order that all
further delays may be obviated.
Respectfully submitted,
Chairman of Committee.
C. M. Wilson
Henry P. Hill
Chas J. Grundling
& Wm. B. Reay.
